 Safeguarding Your Data,
Empowering Your Business 
 At D•engage, we prioritize security, compliance, and performance to ensure seamless customer interactions. Our Customer Experience Data Platform (CXDP) is built on advanced encryption, strict compliance frameworks, and a privacy-centric approach to safeguard your business and customer data. 
 Learn more 
 Contact Us 
 Trusted by more than 300 leading brands in more than 30 countries 
Trust D•engage to Secure Your Data
 At D•engage, we embed security, compliance, and trust at the core of our platform. Certified for ISO 27001 and ISO 27701 and fully GDPR and KVKK compliant, our platform offers businesses complete assurance that their customer data is managed with the highest level of protection. Our approach ensures that brands can engage with their audiences while meeting stringent privacy and security standards.
 Learn more about privacy
Enterprise-Grade Security
 Data security is fundamental to our platform’s architecture. During transmission, TLS 1.3+ encryption safeguards data integrity, preventing unauthorized access. Additionally, API requests are encrypted beyond HTTPS/TLS, ensuring secure communication while data is being exchanged.
 See security and privacy policy
Ongoing Security Audits & Compliance
 D•engage undergoes regular third-party security assessments to validate and enhance our data protection measures. Our internal controls are continuously refined to align with the highest global security benchmarks, including ISO 27001 and ISO 27701, ensuring operational effectiveness and compliance.
 Discover more about system policy
 Engagement at Full Speed, Security at Full Strength
—Powered by D•engage
 Compliance & Privacy
 D•engage meets internationally recognized security standards, including ISO/IEC 27001, ISO 27701, CSA STAR, and GDPR. Our platform provides tools for managing consent, handling data access requests, and ensuring regulatory compliance, empowering businesses with full control over customer data.
 Advanced Encryption & Security
 Data processed by D•engage is encrypted during transmission using TLS 1.3+ to ensure security while in transit. API communication is further protected with additional encryption measures beyond HTTPS/TLS. Access to sensitive data is strictly controlled through role-based access control (RBAC) and multi-factor authentication (MFA)
 Reliability & Performance
 D•engage is designed to handle high-scale, real-time customer engagement without disruptions. Our 99.99% uptime guarantee ensures that your marketing automation, segmentation, and personalization efforts remain uninterrupted.
 Responsible AI & Ethical Data Use
 D•engage’s Zeki AI enhances customer engagement through intelligent automation and predictive segmentation while maintaining a strong commitment to privacy and ethical AI use. Our AI models are explainable, auditable, and continuously refined to ensure fairness, transparency, and compliance with regulatory frameworks.
 Access Control & Data Protection
 D•engage enforces strict security measures, including account-specific IP restrictions for API and panel access. Compliant with GDPR and KVKK, we safeguard customer data while monitoring employee access through video recordings. Our database is continuously monitored to detect and prevent unauthorized access, ensuring data integrity and security.
Certifications & Compliance at the Core of D·engage
 D·engage is ISO 27001, ISO 27701, SOC 2 Type II, GDPR, and KVKK compliant, ensuring your data is protected with industry-best security practices. Our certifications demonstrate a commitment to encryption, data privacy, and system integrity—delivering a secure and compliant experience for your business.
ISO/IEC 27001
 Global standard for information security management.
ISO/IEC 27701
 Extension of ISO 27001 for privacy information management.
SOC 2 Type II
 Certification for service organization controls over data security and privacy.
EU/US GDPR
 Data protection regulation ensuring privacy rights for individuals.
CSA
 Certified Senders Alliance ensuring email security and compliance.
KVKK
 Turkey's personal data protection law, ensuring compliance with data privacy standards.
